widgets.title: Database Availability Uptime %
widgets.description: Availability (available) is a point-in-time signal: "can I reach this database right now?" It's a binary 0 or 1 captured each collection cycle.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND checkType != 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance

widgets.title: Health Check Error Rate
widgets.description: Error rate across all check types (implicit, explicit, query). A non-zero rate indicates connectivity, auth, or query issues.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE hasError = 1) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}})

widgets.title: DB Fleet Status
widgets.description: How many instances are reporting and their current availability state.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(label.instance) as 'total instances', filter(uniqueCount(label.instance), WHERE available = 1) AS 'up', filter(uniqueCount(label.instance), WHERE available = 0) AS 'down' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND checkType != 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) SINCE 10 minutes ago

rawConfiguration.text:
## Database Availability & Uptime
---

[nri-mysql GitHub](https://github.com/newrelic/nri-mysql) | [New Relic MySQL docs](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/infrastructure/host-integrations/host-integrations-list/mysql/mysql-integration/) | [NRQL reference](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/nrql/get-started/introduction-nrql-new-relics-query-language/)

---

#### Availability
A **point-in-time** signal captured each collection cycle: *can I reach this database right now?*

All checks emit `MysqlHealthSample` with a `checkType` attribute:

| checkType | Method | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| **implicit** | MySQL protocol [COM_PING](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_protocol_com_ping.html) | Server is listening and responds at the wire level |
| **explicit** | Canary SQL query (e.g. `SELECT 1`) | Query parser, execution engine, and auth layer are functional |
| **query** | Internal monitoring queries | Individual query health and duration |

> Implicit is lightweight but won't catch thread exhaustion or read-only violations. Explicit exercises the full query path.

**Important:** These checks measure availability *from the integration's perspective* using a single monitoring user. Not every error means the database is down for all consumers. For example, an `mysql_error_1045` (access denied) may indicate a credential issue specific to the monitoring user while the database remains fully available to application traffic. This makes availability monitoring a strong proxy for uptime, but not a guarantee — treat it as one signal alongside application-level health checks.

---

#### Uptime %
Availability **aggregated over a time window** — what fraction of checks succeeded?

Uptime % = (successful checks / total checks) × 100

At a **10s interval** over 5 minutes ≈ 30 checks. If 1 fails → **96.7% uptime**.

---

#### MysqlHealthSample Schema

All `MysqlHealthSample` events share:
- `hasError` (0/1) — single field to find all errors
- `errorCode` — classified error type
- `errorMessage` — sanitized error detail
- `durationMs` — execution time

See [NRQL reference](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/nrql/get-started/introduction-nrql-new-relics-query-language/) for custom queries against this event type.

#### Connection Timing (implicit/explicit only)

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| **`durationMs`** | Total round-trip time: DNS + TCP + TLS + MySQL auth + query response |
| **`dnsLookupMs`** | Time to resolve the hostname to an IP via DNS |
| **`tcpConnectMs`** | Time for the TCP three-way handshake to the resolved IP |
| **`tlsHandshakeMs`** | TLS handshake duration (0 when TLS is not configured) |

> A spike in DNS or TCP time indicates infrastructure issues, not MySQL. A spike in `tlsHandshakeMs` suggests certificate or cipher negotiation overhead. Compare TLS-enabled vs non-TLS instances to isolate TLS cost.

See [MySQL Encrypted Connections](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/encrypted-connections.html) for TLS configuration.

---

#### Error Codes

Classified `errorCode` values emitted in `MysqlHealthSample`. Codes prefixed `mysql_error_` map to the [MySQL Server Error Reference](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/mysql-errors/8.0/en/server-error-reference.html).

| errorCode | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `dns_resolution_failed` | Container stop / DNS failure |
| `connection_refused` | Port reject / iptables |
| `timeout` | Container pause / connection hang |
| `mysql_error_1045` | [Access denied](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/mysql-errors/8.0/en/server-error-reference.html#error_er_access_denied_error) — wrong credentials |
| `invalid_connection` | Server-side connection kill |
| `tls_error` | [TLS handshake failure](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/encrypted-connections.html) |
| `connection_reset` | TCP RST / connection reset |
| `server_closed_connection` | Server closed connection unexpectedly |
| `unknown_error` | Unclassified errors |

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND checkType != 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance, label.availability_zone

widgets.title: Response Time — max (ms)
widgets.description: Connection phase breakdown: DNS resolution, TCP handshake, TLS handshake (when enabled), and total query duration. Non-TLS instances (e.g. inventorydb) will show 0 for TLS Handshake — compare against TLS-enabled instances to see the overhead.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT max(durationMs) AS 'total', max(dnsLookupMs) AS 'dns', max(tcpConnectMs) AS 'tcp', max(tlsHandshakeMs) AS 'tls' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) TIMESERIES FACET label.instance

widgets.title: Availability by Service and AZ
widgets.description: Uptime grouped by availability zone — surfaces zone-specific outages.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND checkType != 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET label.service_name, label.availability_zone

widgets.title: Availability by Service
widgets.description: Uptime grouped by service_name — useful for comparing health across deploys.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE available = 1) AS 'Uptime %' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND checkType != 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET label.service_name

widgets.title: Response Time — avg (ms)
widgets.description: Average connection duration per instance. TLS-enabled instances include TLS handshake overhead; non-TLS instances show baseline TCP performance.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs) AS 'total', average(dnsLookupMs) AS 'dns', average(tcpConnectMs) AS 'tcp', average(tlsHandshakeMs) AS 'tls' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType IN ({{checkType}}) AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET label.instance

widgets.title: Slowest Queries — avg (ms)
widgets.description: Top internal monitoring queries by average duration. High values may indicate MySQL server pressure.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs) AS 'avg' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET queryName LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Query Duration — avg / p95 (ms)
widgets.description: Internal monitoring query performance trends. Spikes correlate with MySQL load.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(durationMs) AS 'avg', percentile(durationMs, 95) AS 'p95' FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE checkType = 'query' AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET label.instance TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Errors Over Time
widgets.description: Error count by classified error code across all check types.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET errorCode, label.instance TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET errorCode

widgets.title: Recent Errors
widgets.description: Most recent error per unique error code/message combination.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(errorMessage), latest(durationMs), latest(checkType) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE hasError = 1 AND label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET errorCode, label.instance, label.service_name

widgets.title: Health Check Configuration
widgets.description: Active check types and canary queries per monitored instance.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(query), latest(label.role), latest(label.service_name), latest(label.availability_zone), latest(label.environment) FROM MysqlHealthSample WHERE label.instance IN ({{instance}}) AND label.service_name IN ({{service_name}}) AND label.role IN ({{role}}) AND label.environment IN ({{environment}}) FACET label.instance SINCE 30 minutes ago
